title: Incorrect pricing
body: Their app claims that their subscription prices are $5.99 monthly or $47.99 annually. However, when you actually hit the subscribe button, you discover on the Apple-provided overlay that the real prices are $7.49 for the monthly and $59.99 annually. This is false advertising.
author: StoreyLane

title: A Game-Changer for ADHD - 5 Stars!
body:
Focus Genie has been a life-altering tool for me as a black woman with ADHD. It's comprehensive, offering strategies and education that resonate with my neurodivergent brain. It's not just an app; it's a personal guide that's accessible and easy to navigate. 

Beyond helping me understand ADHD, Focus Genie has been instrumental in my day-to-day life, aiding my healing process and enhancing my productivity. A huge thank you to Dr. Sasha Hamdani for creating such a powerful tool.

For anyone living with ADHD, I can't recommend Focus Genie enough. It's a beacon of hope, proving that with the right resources, we can thrive. Five stars aren't enough for this transformative app.

Diane Rudakenga
author: Diana Lion Queen

title: Enjoying new app but
body: I am enjoying this new app! I like the tracking items like water, focus, food and sleep. I wish I were able to also track exercise and medication as these are two large pieces in my daily management and would like to see how these impact my focus and productivity.
author: Melce

title: Fantastic app for ADHD
body: As an early app, I did have a few issues in the first few days but they were all fixed after the first update. The journal prompts are great and I am enjoying using the timer with brown noise. To do list is also helpful. The learning section is also awesome for helping to understand how and why ADHD impacts me daily.
author: StewJu

title: Early days
body:
I was really excited to try this app, and continue to have high hopes but it needs some improvement. It won’t let me check off my To Do list as it keeps saying it’s in read only. 
I also would like to see some To Dos carry over to the next day because they are daily tasks not just tasks I want to do that particular day. Recreating a new task list daily is too hard for me. 

I think this app has the best potential I’ve seen among ADHD apps so far! I think after a few iterations I’d be ready to subscribe again. I would really like to see what my monthly data collection would tell me. 
Unfortunately it has only a 3 day trial so I unsubscribed prior to exploring any more of what it had to offer. 

Looking forward to seeing how this app evolves after feedback!
author: jakibnot

title: Beware - no real trial
body:
Beware before you download - this app requires you to hand over your credit card info prior to the 3- day trial. So, you cannot even trial it, and see if it is for you without subscribing. 

Yes, they say you can cancel within the three days and you will allegedly not be charged, but I’ve seen that not happen with so many apps. I’ve found honest app companies let you trial it or at least look around at the locked content before you hand over your credit card. Not certain why they are not doing this? Too bad as I was excited to try it. 

Can’t really rate it well. Can’t even go back and look at the initial product run-through. It’s just stuck on the subscription screen. The rating is based on above.
author: Mirra435
